# RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.7.0 — AI Quick Reference

- [Full .rshp Specification, RaggieScript Hooks & CLI Guide](./llms-full.txt)
- [Agent Skill Instructions](./SKILL.md)
- Binaries (100% Static `/MT` Win32 C++20, `x64` & `ARM64`): `HelpStudio.exe` (9-View Visual IDE), `rshbuild.exe`, `RaggieSoftHelp.exe`, `rshtests.exe`.
- Licensing: Zero-activation offline NIST P-256 ECDSA `.rswlic` verification (`No License File == Community Edition` with 100% `Architect` parity).
- RaggieScript v1.3 (`use help;` / `RSW702` Sandbox): `help.includeWhen`, `help.registerSearchAlias`, `help.routeContextId`, `help.reportBrokenAnchor`, and `test "..."` assertions.
- RaggieSoft Reference Portals: Compiles standalone three-column searchable developer documentation websites (`Ctrl+K` symbol search, live TOC filter, Master A-Z API Index, `llms-full.txt`, & VPAT 2.5).
- Legacy Decompilers: Raw `.chm` (`ITSF` v3 + `LZX`), `.hhp`/`.hhc`/`.hhk`, raw `.hlp` (`3F 5F 03 00` B+ tree + `LZ77`) + `.cnt`, and `.hpj` + Word footnote `.rtf`.
